.. change::
    :tags: bug, autogenerate, postgresql
    :tickets: 1462

    Fixed false-positive "Computed default cannot be modified" warning emitted
    during autogenerate when comparing PostgreSQL :class:`.Computed` columns
    whose reflected SQL expression includes type cast specifiers such as
    ``::regconfig`` or ``::text``, which PostgreSQL adds to the expression as
    stored.  These cast specifiers are now stripped before comparison so that
    otherwise equivalent expressions no longer trigger the warning.  Pull
    request courtesy Sebastian Cao.

.. change::
    :tags: bug, autogenerate, postgresql

    Fixed issue where autogenerate would detect an unchanged PostgreSQL
    expression-based index as modified when the expression included type
    casts, such as a cast to a type with a length or precision, a nested
    cast, or a cast followed by a ``DESC`` modifier.
